items.title: Wild Darkest Hour Warlock has ruined the game for me
items.text:
Wild Darkest Hour Warlock has ruined the game for me
darkest hour is used in 0 standard decks and the deck has a 60% winrate in wild. 



https://hsreplay.net/decks/aAHdZVNeOPqZFe9PUYrNSb/#gameType=RANKED_WILD


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AUvabFD2qdY



This is why I've uninstalled hearthstone, it's a deliberate ploy by Blizzard to ruin wild, which was unbalanced before, but never to this extent. 

a board full of 9 mana minions where spells cost 4 more and the hero is immune on turn 4.

the giant decks, even pally and jade druid were never this oppressive or ended the game that early. 


this is a 3 card combo deck that consistently wins turn 4-6 in warlock. either bloodbloom or darkest hour deserve a nerf. 

idc anymore, i uninstalled. this game is dead.
none of hearthstone is skilled or hard, it doesn't make deliberate game breaking mechanics okay, especially when the card has no standard gameplay.

Stop making excuses for poor game design.



I don't like standard because of the limited cardpool. it forces people to netdeck and i have no interest in playing against the same 3 decks repeatedly. 


wild has some overpowered interactions and I'm fine with all of them apart from this, there is no counterplay apart from playing a mill rouge deck. 

combo decks that spawn a full board of spell resistant buffed 9 mana minions on turn 4-6 shouldn't exist, even the tokens are board clear resistant.

overpowered interactions are what every single deck is based around. without them it'd be vanilla minions.


this is not comparable. it's removing all choice from the game. it's solitaire.


I won't be missed because hearthstone won't exist in 2 expansions, it's a dead game.

hearthstone is dependant on luck and the deck you chose. apart from basic math it doesn't require skill. 

the only skill involved is deck building i.e. arena/ home brewed decks.

I don't expect them to balance wild, I expect them to not create new cards with no function in standard specifically to disrupt wild.

like darkest hour. also wild players still buy packs, most of blizzards whales are wild players. new players make up standard and ae usually f2p. 


hearthstones number of accounts is increasing but the daily users is decreasing every expansion. 2018 being the first year without acitve user growth.
hearthstone isn't a skill based game... it used to be a fun game if that helps?
I'm just not going to play card games? I think i'll live
why? most of the design team go on this sub, how are they going to know they're assholes if i don't mention it?

no, for designing a card to disrupt a format. Darkest Hour is played in no current standard decks, it was designed solely to disrupt wild.

the card will never see play without bloodbloom support. they could have easily reworded it "summon a random minion of the same cost" and it would see the same amount of play in standard.
oh synergy? with a card that has synergy with every non battlecry minion in the game? great.
no, just dying, with active users going down.

same thing they did with Star Aligner, create a card that only has synergy with wild cards to force users into standard.

reading the text of the card anyone who's not disabled could see it's applications in wild. it's like bloodbloom is an unplayed card, we seen it in standard for mechathun warlock, they planned this deck.

people in this subreddit always defend blizzard game design, but get mad over a 4 mana 7-7?

thing is it's not even inconsistent, the deck has a 60% winrate

anything over 55% deserves a nerf imo, that's what they do in other games. 

thing is that 60% is only going to get higher, odd and even paladin have been perfected, this cancer was only created a few days ago.
why?

there are like 6 different decks in wild with a winrate over 68%, they don't care about wild or balance, they don't even seem to care about money. 

they 100% knew about this deck, just like the star one. even if they didn't they have analytics from every game. they can see this deck is an issue. no combo deck should win turn 4.
standard is a joke, homogenised gameplay with too few options for deck building
yes they do
I wouldn't be surprised if half this subreddit is Blizzards pr team, I'm glad i won't be dealing with you anymore

well no, they only created the card to drive people out of wild for a new expansion. 

they only decided to nerf it after the standard rotation had grown stale and more people went back to wild.

no. this is different because it requires no set up and is impossible to clear. 

there is no other wild deck that can even remotely put that many stats on the board on turn 4, never mind your hero being immune and spells costing 4 more.
there is no way to kill this combo on turn 4. for any class. rouge can do it with prep vanish if the +4 spell modifier isn't in play.
wild is fine apart from even paladin hero power and darkest hour. nothing else needs a nerf.

it is deliberate, there's no way it wasn't spotted in playtesting. bloodbloom has been used in wild for the last year. they even included token minion spells to support darkest hour.

hearthstone has never been a skill based game but this is a joke, there's no counterplay.
i actually laughed lol
Kaido's insight will spoil too much, he's gonna kill big mom this arc, we'll see what his plans are then
